title: diagnostics.list input
description: List the diagnostics currently shown in the Error List: errors, warnings and messages, each with its file, line, column, code and message, and its source (the last build, the live analysis, both, or the last test run's failures). Optionally filter by severity and source.

severity.description: Only return diagnostics of this severity. Omit to return all. Names follow the Visual Studio Error List (Errors, Warnings, Messages).

source.description: Only return diagnostics from this source: build (the last build's, including those the live analysis reports too), live (the language server's and the solution load's, including those the build reports too) or test (the last test run's failures). Omit to return all.
